{"n": 969, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Pohár bol prázdny, tak ho ona naplnila limonádou.", "pronoun": "ona", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg fem subject of naplnila"},
{"n": 970, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Ten balón je väčší než ona — jej pľúca musia byť obrovské.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
{"n": 971, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Keby atletika tu nebola taká populárna, ten štadión by bol spolovice prázdny.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
{"n": 972, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Samozrejme, ak má izba rovnaké postele, nikto sa nehádá o to, kde spať.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
{"n": 973, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Ona maľuje každé leto, ale minulé leto nenamaľovala nič.", "pronoun": "ona", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg fem subject"},
{"n": 974, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Napriek tomu, že lúč vyprchal, on kolená stále necíti.", "pronoun": "on", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg masc subject of necíti"},
{"n": 975, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Medveď sa na kameru pozerá veľmi pokojne", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
{"n": 976, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Oni zvyčajne veľa rozprávajú, ale dnes večer boli ticho.", "pronoun": "oni", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3pl subject"},
{"n": 977, "action": "R", "sk_new": "O šiestej oni už budú pochodovať mestom štyri hodiny.", "pronoun": "oni", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3pl subject of budú pochodovať"},
{"n": 978, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Toto mesto ty musíš raz v živote vidieť.", "pronoun": "ty", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 2sg subject of musíš"},
{"n": 979, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Podnos, ktorý bol veľký ako dvere od auta, niesol jedno malé sústo jedla.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
{"n": 980, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Ono je pri otvore — ide vojsť dnu.", "pronoun": "ono", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg subject; English 'it' -> neuter"},
{"n": 981, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Štyria priatelia spolu dokončia dobrodružstvo.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
{"n": 982, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Priala by si ona, aby podlaha pod nohami bola z pevného sivého kameňa.", "pronoun": "ona", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg fem subject of priala by si"},
{"n": 983, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Na jeden beh ona nepotrebuje veľa vody.", "pronoun": "ona", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg fem subject"},
{"n": 984, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Do večera oni priradia každú fotku v tom sprievodcovi.", "pronoun": "oni", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3pl subject"},
{"n": 985, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Úprimne, ty si vyhral s touto posádkou túto sezónu desať pretekov.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},

{"n": 988, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Kto vyhráva zlatú trofej? Modrý tím.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
